app.name: CodeBurn
app.one_liner: A local-first CLI and macOS menubar tool that tracks AI coding token usage, cost, and performance across 18+ tools by reading session data directly from disk with no API keys or proxies.

screens.name: Interactive TUI Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display real-time and historical AI coding cost, token usage, and performance metrics across projects, models, and providers with time-range navigation.
primary_actions: Export data as JSON or CSV
Switch between time ranges (Today, 7 Days, 30 Days, Month, 6 Months)

rust_commands.name: compare_models
rust_commands.purpose: Fetch side-by-side metrics (cost, tokens, speed) for different models or providers over a specified period.

rust_commands.name: list_items
rust_commands.purpose: Retrieve and filter session records by time range, provider, or project for display in the dashboard or export.

rust_commands.name: optimize_insights
rust_commands.purpose: Scan historical usage to identify wasteful patterns (e.g., high-cost low-yield sessions) and generate actionable copy-paste fixes.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist parsed session data including tokens, cost, model, provider, and timestamps to local storage for aggregation and reporting.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add export functionality (JSON/CSV) and basic optimization heuristic
week 1: Build core TUI dashboard with time-range filtering and auto-refresh
week 1: Implement local session file parser for at least 3 major AI coding tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor)
week 1: Integrate LiteLLM-based cost calculator with model alias resolution
acceptance_tests: On Node.js 22.13+, CodeBurn correctly ingests Cursor session data via better-sqlite3 and displays non-zero costs in the dashboard.
On Windows, Antigravity sessions are either detected correctly or the system provides a clear warning about unsupported platform behavior.
Running `codeburn optimize` on a dataset containing redundant streaming responses accurately identifies waste and suggests fixes without losing tool_use blocks.
The macOS menubar app installs via `npx codeburn menubar`, clears quarantine attributes, and displays live cost updates matching the CLI dashboard.
